question: In Field Emission, emission is achieved by applying a very strong electric field (order of $10^8 \text{ V/m}$). How does this strong field physically facilitate the escape of electrons?

options.A: It heats the metal rapidly, causing thermionic emission
options.B: It bombards the surface with positive ions to knock out electrons
options.C: It exerts a massive electrostatic force that pulls electrons through the surface barrier
options.D: It lowers the work function to zero so electrons drift out naturally
